title: Hans Bethe House
author: NPS/GLOWINSKI
description: Before he called this his home residence, Dr. Hans Bethe had lived in Strasbourg, Frankfurt, Munich, Stuttgart, and Tubingen, Germany; as well as Cambridge and Manchester, England, Rome, Italy, and Ithaca, New York.
